description_en: Queries the list of hardware O&M events triggered by an Elasticsearch cluster
description_zh: 调用ListInstanceHistoryEvents，查看Elasticsearch集群触发的硬件运维事件列表
kebab_example: aliyun elasticsearch list-instance-history-events --instance-id es-cn-2r42l7a7400050000 --node-ip 10.1.xx.xx --event-type Instance:InstanceFailure.Reboot:Executed --event-level INFO,WARN --event-create-start-time 1645596516000 --event-create-end-time 1645596516000 --event-execute-start-time 1645596516000 --event-execute-end-time 1645596516000 --event-finash-start-time 1645596516000 --event-finash-end-time 1645596516000 --page 0 --size 10 --event-cycle-status EXECUTED,FAILED --biz-body sortField=event_time desc=true --api-version 2017-06-13 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListInstanceHistoryEvents
